beforeAll: (async()=>{const w=t=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,t));for(let i=0;i<100&&!document.querySelector('input[type=email]')&&!document.querySelector('nav');i++)await w(100);const e=document.querySelector('input[type=email]');if(!e)return 'already';const set=(el,v)=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));};set(e,'fixture@example.com');set(document.querySelector('input[type=password]'),'FixturePassword2026');await w(400);[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/^\s*เข้าสู่ระบบ\s*$/.test(b.textContent))?.click();for(let i=0;i<150&&document.querySelector('input[type=password]');i++)await w(100);return 'ok'})()

pages.name: tt-a-warm-light
pages.setup: (async()=>{const w=x=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,x));const go=async h=>{location.hash=h;await w(900)};await go('#/settings?section=appearance');for(let i=0;i<60&&!document.querySelector('input[name=ap-skin]');i++)await w(100);const pick=(n,v)=>{const e=document.querySelector('input[name="'+n+'"][value="'+v+'"]');if(e&&!e.checked)e.click()};pick('ap-skin','warm');await w(500);pick('ap-mode','light');await w(500);pick('ap-timetable','a');await w(500);pick('ap-layout','a');await w(1800);await go('#/timetable');return [document.documentElement.dataset.skin,document.querySelector('input[name=ap-timetable]:checked')?.value].join()})()
